question: After the no-op pacing defect is fixed, should unavailable-reconciler ambiguous outbound rows stay pending and recoverable rather than move to failed while the broader delivery ledger remains open?
rationale: The code can be mechanically repaired, but the final terminal-state behavior changes upgraded users' queue semantics and needs maintainer acceptance of the pending-vs-failed product tradeoff.

options.title: Accept pending with pacing fix
options.body: Keep no-reconciler ambiguous rows pending with backoff after they are classified before replay pacing, preserving future recoverability without blocking newer deliveries.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject this mitigation and keep moving unavailable-reconciler ambiguous rows to failed until the broader delivery ledger and reconciliation design lands.

options.title: Defer to ledger design
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle the behavior only as part of the broader transcript-to-client delivery ledger work.

recommendation.title: Accept pending with pacing fix
recommendation.body: Keep no-reconciler ambiguous rows pending with backoff after they are classified before replay pacing, preserving future recoverability without blocking newer deliveries.
